facts.note: Temple bell strikes nine at dinner; everyone shows watches; Félix's watch shows twenty minutes to nine; Aurèle scolds him. The 'every year' habit is extra colour and is not on the sheet, but it does not alter any fact.
Piquet with the doctor in the salon without a break; temple strikes ten during play; play continues until he goes out for cigars; she did not look at the clock when he left.

He asks her to play for him as he leaves; she sits at the piano at once and plays until he returns, stopping when he comes in. The music named (Chopin) is extra detail and does not change the sequence.
A moment after he comes back, the hall clock strikes eleven.
